mapper.select: SELECT id, conf_value, tenant_id, conf_mac FROM conf_sys_set WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conf_mac = 'crm_mcp_enabled' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conf_sys_set (id, conf_source, conf_mac, conf_name, conf_value, conf_desc, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{confSource}, #{confMac}, #{confName}, #{confValue,javaType=java.lang.Object,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}, #{confDesc}, #{createUserId}, #{createTime}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateTime}, #{tenantId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE conf_value = VALUES(conf_value), update_user_id = VALUES(update_user_id), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
